results.title: The internet has been unreachable for a while
results.fix: Nothing to do, or switch to survival mode with `aictl mode survival`.

results.title: Running on battery
results.fix: Plug in the charger. A laptop server stops when the battery runs out.

results.title: The AI model service is not running
results.fix: Run `aictl restart llama`. If it fails again, run `aictl logs --unit llama`.

results.title: The agent cannot write its state
results.fix: Free disk space on the system disk.
